cells.quote:
To examine the effect of TMR, we first computed the change in the number of names successfully recalled across sleep. This value, Δrecall, did not differ signiﬁcantly between the cued class, designated class C, and the uncued class, designated class U [mean Δrecall 0.75 and 0.21, SDs = 2.03 and 1.70, respectively; t(23) = 0.93, p = 0.36].
